# Prism JavaScript highlighter

Prism 1.30.0: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0

The core, C-like grammar and JavaScript grammar minified files are vendored
unchanged from that release's components directory. See PRISM-LICENSE for the
upstream MIT license. prism-config.mjs enables manual-only highlighting.
No CDN or runtime download is required.
